scientific.integrity: The closest source using the same simplex kernel was materially inspected in full. A later primary-MSC-52A40 projection-body source and exact-object/equivalent-formulation searches were checked. The proof is exact linear algebra and convexity; the bundled finite enumeration is diagnostic only.
limitations: The formulas are Euclidean and apply to the regular simplex; arbitrary affine simplices require a different Euclidean metric analysis.
The theorem does not recompute the classical maximum-volume symmetry ratio and does not settle Brannen's projection-body conjectures.
An equivalent cube-section radius computation may exist in unindexed classical polytope literature.

title: Parity law for Euclidean roundness of the regular-simplex central kernel
